title: Substitute
text: With $$u=y+1$$, $$y-1=u-2$$ and $$dy=du$$, so the integrand becomes $$\frac{u-2}{u}=1-\frac{2}{u}$$.

title: Integrate and back-substitute
text: This gives $$u-2\ln\left(|u|\right)$$. Since $$u=y+1$$ and constants can be absorbed into C, the answer is $$y-2\ln\left(|y+1|\right)+C$$.
